title: Extend Foreign Strings
goal: Add a custom helper method to str using an extension trait.
hints: Implementing a trait for a type uses the impl Trait for Type syntax.
Call the new method defined in your trait on the string slice.
explanation: To extend a standard type like `str`, implement a local trait using `impl IsShort for str`. Inherent implementations on foreign types are prohibited by the orphan rule and produce error `E0116`. Calling `len` causes a type mismatch `E0308` because `check` returns a boolean while `len` returns an integer.
